agent_notes: Government-directory membership is established by the supplied NIRF 2025 Management listing, which shows the exact institution in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh.

Normal TLS verification produced the managed proxy's self-signed-certificate-in-chain error; curl --insecure was then used only for public GET requests to the confirmed expected official hosts www.nirfindia.org and www.iiml.ac.in.
The official homepage and linked programme pages clearly establish the nine formal academic/doctoral programmes listed above.

The official Executive Education page also contains many batch-specific offerings with mixed historical and future dates, third-party registration links, and unclear credential status. The two explicitly identifiable certificate programmes were included, but a complete catalogue-wide import of all executive offerings cannot be established without relying on non-official partner pages; course_catalogue_status is therefore partial_official_website and the record remains manual_review.
Expired short-duration executive entries and news/event items were excluded. No third-party aggregator or social source was used.
IPMX is listed by the official page as a one-year MBA, but the same page says the final degree/diploma status is pending; this ambiguity is preserved in the credential field.
